voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Even its guardians could no longer find this grave. Genghis Khan's. Buried in secret, Mongolia, twelve twenty-seven.
So wrote a Persian historian some eighty years later. The Khan, he said, chose the spot beneath a lone tree.
Then a forest grew so thick that no one could tell which tree it was.
The land around his sacred mountain became the Great Taboo, closed to outsiders for seven centuries.
In twenty ten, ten thousand volunteers searched satellite images. Their map led to fifty-five ancient sites. Not his grave.
